aboutMaya.title: Dr. Maya Adhami
aboutMaya.text: Dr. Maya Adhami is an ENT and Facial Aesthetics specialist with advanced fellowship training in France and over a decade of experience in facial rejuvenation and facial plastic surgery. She is dedicated to delivering natural, refined results through a personalized, evidence-based approach. Recognized as a pioneer in facial aesthetics, she was featured in Forbes Healthcare Middle East in April 2018 for her contributions to the field.

highlights.title: Education
highlights.text: Received a Biology degree from the American University of Beirut. Then I furthered my medical education at the University of Balamand, specializing in Ear, Nose, and Throat and Head & Neck surgery at the Saint George Hospital University Medical Center.

highlights.title: Fellowship
highlights.text: Pursued my fellowship in rhinology and facial plastic surgery in Paris, at the University of Paris Descartes and University Paris 12, where I became a member of the European Academy of Facial Plastic Surgery.

aboutClinic.title: Verdun Clinic
aboutClinic.lead: Where a commitment to excellence meets a passion for personalized care?

highlights.text: Nestled in the heart of Beirut, in the vibrant district of Verdun, our clinic stands as a beacon of health and wellness.
From advanced medical services to cutting-edge cosmetic treatments, we provide a comprehensive range of healthcare solutions.
Our team of dedicated professionals, led by Dr. Maya Adhami, ensures a welcoming environment where your well-being comes first.
Experience the synergy of expertise, innovation, and compassion at Verdun Clinic—a place where your journey to optimal health and beauty begins.
